step: Step 27 (part of V28) - fixed Yukawa branch local gravity test
series: Time Attraction Law - Scalar-Tensor Yukawa Fit, V28 (V28 = V27 Step 26 cosmology package + interactive simulator + this Step 27)
convention: V = -G_inf m1 m2/r (1 + alpha exp(-r/lambda)); G_lab = G_inf (1+alpha) for r << lambda

model.universality: universal: all matter couples to A^2(phi) g
model.screening: none in the fixed branch (package: 'no screening branch is introduced')

sources.content: action with kinetic term c^4/(4 pi G beta_Yuk), matter coupled to A^2(phi) g, A = exp(alpha_Y phi); point source phi = -alpha_Y beta_Yuk G M exp(-r/L)/(c^2 r). Test-mass potential c^2 alpha_Y phi = -alpha_Y^2 beta_Yuk G M exp(-r/L)/r, i.e. alpha = q
G_lab: for r << L and unscreened small bodies Phi = -G_* M (1 + q e^{-r/L})/r, G_lab ~ G_*(1+q), q = alpha_Y^2 beta_Yuk
alpha_std = alpha_Y/(4 pi) = 2 beta^2; G_eff(r) = G[1 + alpha_std (1 + r/L) e^{-r/L}]; r << L: G_eff -> G(1 + alpha_std). ('screened' at line 100 only means exp(-r/L) decay)
chameleon/symmetron screening is a standalone nonlinear extension hypothesis beyond the quadratic constant-alpha_Y Yukawa action, i.e. not part of the fixed branch

ratio_to_bound_definition: R = alpha_model / alpha_lim(lambda=10 km). Interpretable only in the convention above and under the stated assumptions; R > 1: model point outside the published/re-derived allowed region. R is not a significance and is never quoted in sigma.

verdict.label: Step 27 (part of V28)
verdict.scope: fixed, unscreened, universal local Yukawa branch (alpha = 0.0795775, lambda = 10 km) only; not all TAL variants
verdict.not_a_reopening_of: Step 26 (V26/V27 kinetic normalization) is not re-opened; S01 concerns only holding G_lab fixed in a new parameter-limit search
verdict.status: strong tension only in this sense: in the idealized layer/half-space models, under the assumed error reading, a large numerical discrepancy results. Not an empirical exclusion with a confidence level.
verdict.status_hu: erős feszültség csak ebben az értelemben: az idealizált réteg-/féltérmodellekben, a feltételezett hibaértelmezés mellett nagy numerikus eltérés adódik. Nem konfidenciaszinttel rendelkező empirikus kizárás.
verdict.R_status: CONDITIONAL: denominator alpha_lim ~ 0.0023 is an unverified re-derivation
verdict.statement_en: Our own re-derivation indicates strong tension with the fixed, unscreened Yukawa branch; confirming an exclusion requires verification of the measurement response and the uncertainty treatment.
verdict.statement_hu: A saját újraszármaztatás erős feszültséget jelez a rögzített, árnyékolatlan Yukawa-ággal; a kizárás megerősítéséhez a mérési válasz és a bizonytalanságkezelés ellenőrzése szükséges.
